text:
jen: Heads-up: small but reproducible mismatch between invoice preview and final for a handful of EU tenants after route-resolver v2 rolled last night. preview shows extra tokens in `unattributed`.

david: which part of v2? fingerprinting reorder?

jen: yes, resolver now runs later in preview topology due to topic choice. finalizer sees enriched events; preview reads raw stream and shows fallback.

maya: any customer impact?

jen: no final invoices harmed, but CS got 3 tickets after they looked at preview per-route breakdown.

alan: quick idea: switch preview consumer to enriched topic as a canary for the region. low-risk config flip.

metering-bot: detected 48 preview events with null route_resolution in eu cluster between 1767775900..1767776000.

jen: starting canary on one partition now.

sre-bot: deploy kicked: preview-consumer-read-enriched.canary (eu).

jen: canary result: preview delta dropped from ~2.1% -> 0.25% in ~6 minutes.

david: short-term UX: add a tiny banner on the preview card: "Preview may be inconsistent during routing rollouts" with a link to runbook.

maya: I'll draft the CS blurb and add reconcile query to runbook.

elena: for support, can we give a quick SQL snippet to reconcile?

maya: yes: SELECT session_id, SUM(tokens) FROM preview WHERE ts>t0 GROUP BY session_id; join with final.

alan: long-term, we should either move enrichment upstream or unify preview/final paths. adding an `inflight_enrichment` tag would help UI confidence.

jen: opening ticket MP-2021 "preview attribution race on route-resolver rollout" assigned to jen/alan/david.

david: also adding a temporary grafana alert: preview_vs_final_delta.eu > 1% triggers a slack ping.

jen: canary stable for 30m; promoting region-wide. will keep the banner until design decision. closing thread unless issues. :thumbsup:

elena: thanks, will update the CS ticket responses.
